sources.title: Visa Waiver Program
sources.officialityEvidence: The page states it is managed by the U.S. Department of State and is published on travel.state.gov.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Travelers must have a valid Electronic System for Travel Authorization approval prior to travel.

policies.title: United States Visa Waiver Program: ESTA-required nationality cohort
policies.summary: The State Department lists these VWP nationalities and requires valid ESTA approval for qualifying short tourism or business travel without a visa.
conditions: The traveller must be a citizen or national of a listed VWP country and hold an ICAO-compliant ePassport.
Valid ESTA approval is required before travel; ESTA is not a guarantee of admission.
The permitted purpose is visitor-business, tourism, or generally transit; credit study, employment, foreign-media work, and permanent residence are excluded.
The stay is limited to 90 days or less; travel on a private aircraft or a non-VWP-approved air or sea carrier requires a visa.
A British traveller must be a British citizen with unrestricted permanent abode in the United Kingdom, Channel Islands, or Isle of Man.
Taiwan is included under the Taiwan Relations Act designation stated by the Department of State.
A VWP traveller must obtain a visa after presence in DPRK, Iran, Iraq, Libya, Somalia, Sudan, Syria, or Yemen on or after 2011-03-01, subject to stated diplomatic or military exceptions.
A VWP traveller must obtain a visa after presence in Cuba on or after 2021-01-12, subject to stated diplomatic or military exceptions.
A VWP traveller must obtain a visa if also a national of Cuba, DPRK, Iran, Iraq, Sudan, or Syria.
Emergency or temporary passports must also be ePassports; special diplomatic, official, refugee, and other travel-document treatment is not established by this policy.

application.label: Official ESTA application website
steps: Use the official CBP ESTA website to request travel authorisation.
Obtain valid ESTA approval before travelling under the Visa Waiver Program.
